newsitem.title: USA: Clinton says U.S. wants to give N. Korea more food.
newsitem.headline: Clinton says U.S. wants to give N. Korea more food.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton said the United States would like to do more to provide more food aid to famine-threatened North Korea.

"I'm profoundly troubled by the reports that I have read about the scope of human suffering in North Korea and whenever we've been asked we've come up with some more food, but I'd like for us to do more now and I think you'll see ... other countries willing to do more as well," Clinton told reporters.
Clinton spoke on Sunday after the conclusion of the Group of Seven summit here.

The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies on Thursday appealed for 26 million francs ($18 million) to increase food and medical aid to North Korea, where reports claim millions are at risk of starvation.
